wiki.title: Ann Bollin
wiki.extract: Ann Marie Bollin (born August 18, 1960) is an American politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since 2019, currently representing the 49th district. A member of the Republican Party, Bollin previously served as the Brighton Township Clerk from 2003 to 2018.
